# Week 9 Start/Sit Briefing -- Saturday, final call

**Source:** Committed fixture `weekly-report-week-9.json` (FantasyPros consensus + ESPN injuries, generated 2026-11-03T17:15:16Z), overlaid with live `nflreadpy.load_injuries(2026)`. **Not live** -- see Source banner for exactly what the overlay could and couldn't confirm. Current week (9) cross-checked against `load_schedules()`: Thursday's BAL@JAX is final (33-10, not on this roster); every other Week 9 game is Sunday 11/8 or Monday 11/9.

## Start these ten

| Slot | Player | Opponent | Expected | If he plays | P(play) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| QB | Matthew Stafford | vs WAS (Sun 1:00pm ET) | **17.00** | 18.59 | 91.4% |
| RB | Jonathan Taylor | vs DAL (Sun 1:00pm ET) | **17.77** | 18.57 | 95.7% |
| RB | Bucky Irving | @ CHI (Sun 8:20pm ET) | **15.90** | 16.62 | 95.7% |
| WR | Jaxon Smith-Njigba | vs ARI (Sun 4:25pm ET) | **23.34** | 24.04 | 97.1% |
| WR | Tee Higgins | @ ATL (Sun 9:30am ET) | **15.86** | 16.36 | 96.9% |
| TE | Isaiah Likely | @ PHI (Sun 1:00pm ET) | **12.55** | 13.21 | 95.0% |
| FLEX | Drake London | vs CIN (Sun 9:30am ET) | **15.45** | 17.01 | 90.8% |
| FLEX | Jameson Williams | @ MIA (Sun 1:00pm ET) | **12.55** | 12.95 | 96.9% |
| K | Jake Bates | @ MIA (Sun 1:00pm ET) | **8.09** | 8.21 | 98.6% |
| DEF | Jets D/ST | @ KC (Sun 1:00pm ET) | **5.63** | 5.63 | 100% |

**Lineup total: 144.14 expected points.**

Bench: Tyler Shough (QB, 17.00/0.972 -- tied with Stafford, see Changes), Bo Nix (QB, 15.60), Cam Skattebo (RB, 10.49, Questionable/hamstring), Sam LaPorta (TE, 11.95), Jalen Coker (WR, 10.55).

## Changes since Wednesday

Only one: **QB flips from Shough to Stafford**, pure tie-break, not a projection change (both 17.00 expected). Wednesday defaulted to the lower-variance Shough with Stafford's Questionable (Arm) tag unconfirmed. Since then Stafford logged Full Participation at Friday practice -- the strongest positive signal available short of an outright clearance -- and his conditional ceiling (18.59) is the higher one if he plays. Revert to Shough if Sunday's inactives list downgrades him; nothing else in the lineup moved.

## Watch list

- **Matthew Stafford** (Questionable, Arm) -- Full practice participation, but no official LAR game-status has posted yet. Check before the 1:00pm ET lock.
- **Drake London** (Questionable, Head) -- ATL has filed nothing in nflreadpy for Week 9 at all. Started regardless (clears every bench option even at 90.8%), but his 9:30am ET kickoff is the first lock of the weekend -- highest-priority check tomorrow morning.
- **Cam Skattebo** (bench RB, Questionable, Hamstring, DNP Friday) -- doesn't change the lineup, but is the direct RB backup if Taylor or Irving gets a late scratch.

## Opponent notes

- Smith-Njigba's 23.34 is an outlier even for him -- Arizona's pass defense is bottom-tier, and the gap over the next-best WR (Higgins, 15.86) is 7.5 points.
- London and Higgins share the 9:30am ET London-set window (ATL vs CIN) -- correlated, not a conflict; both start regardless.
- LaPorta sits despite a plus matchup (vs MIA) -- Likely's edge is a thin 0.60 points, worth a last look if either TE's status changes.

## Byes ahead -- plan now, not in two weeks

- **Week 10:** Bucky Irving (starting RB2) and Bo Nix (bench QB) both out.
- **Week 11:** Matthew Stafford, Jaxon Smith-Njigba, **and** Drake London all out together -- three of this week's top five scorers, including the single best player on the roster (JSN) and both of this week's QB options reduced to one (Nix, with Shough as the only other arm). Five bench spots cannot absorb a QB-plus-two-WR hole in one week on top of Irving's Week 10 absence. Start watching the waiver wire and trade market now.

## Sanity checks

Lineup total 144.14 is above the 100-140 band's midpoint but matches Wednesday's total exactly off the same fixture, driven by Smith-Njigba's real outlier week rather than a pipeline problem. No roster player's game has been played yet, so no fixture number was overridden with a real stat line this run. nflreadpy's injury feed has not posted a final Friday game-status for any of this roster's three Questionable players -- that's a known sandbox data-lag limit (ESPN/Sleeper are proxy-blocked here), not a new finding; the fixture's designations stand and should be rechecked against Sunday's actual inactives list.
